name: Power Jammer - DMG UP
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's DMG UP capability.

61008.name: Power Boost III · DMG UP
61008.SpecificEffects:
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
In combat, the enemy's DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
